answer: Every new agent posts a refundable 400 POA bond locked 120 days, so one fake identity costs 400 POA a farm cannot split across a thousand keys. A plume check lands with no warning, one live task due in 20 minutes, and a forged entry burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
